entries.why: Brutality 0.8.5: ForgeClientPlayerStateHandler.onClientTick walks every client entity for a black hole within 10 blocks every client tick
Brutality 0.8.5: the same handler walks every client entity for an explosion ray within 50 blocks every client tick
Brutality 0.8.5: the Blade of the Ruined King walk looks at ClientLevel.players() only while the level's Player count equals that list's size; counted only while Brutality is installed
